One of two [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]], '''Dox Ocean''' was known&mdash;alongside its counterpart, [[Caz Ocean]]&mdash;to the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Akwin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as "[[Father Ocean]]." It also hosted a wide variety of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] lifeforms that were important to both the Akwin and the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lazerian (people)|population]] for [[Diet/Legends|sustenance]].

==Description==
Dox Ocean was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. Located to the east of the continent [[Doxet]] and opposite [[Caz Ocean]]&mdash;which was to the continent's west&mdash;Dox Ocean spanned the eastern portion of the eastern hemisphere and stretched to both of the planet's poles. It continued until the west coast of the continent [[Laz]] in the western hemisphere and also entirely surrounded the continents of [[Torm]] and [[Elgar]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Akwin]], knew both Caz and Dox Ocean collectively as "[[Father Ocean]]." The [[City/Legends|cities]] [[Tormaine]], [[Lazeria City]], and [[Devit (city)|Devit]]&mdash;the former of which was on Torm and the latter two of which were on Laz&mdash;bordered the coastal waters of Dox Ocean.<ref name="TSoK" />

Both [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] hosted an abundance of [[Water/Legends|marine]] life, including many aquatic [[Plant/Legends|plants]], numerous sea creatures with some small in size, and [[Coral/Legends|coral]]. The native [[Human/Legends|human]] population of Lazerian IV, the [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerians]], utilized the practice of [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] to catch marine life for [[Diet/Legends|consumption]], and the Akwin also relied on the marine life for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Underneath the waves of the oceans were a large number of Akwin [[City-state/Legends|city-states]], which were protected from the Lazerians' detection due to [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] that blocked [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans, which were in abundance in the water.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dox Ocean was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
